question: Take the interaction partners of TP53 in the Human Protein Atlas. How many are there? Give the distribution of their main subcellular location as a bar chart and the fraction whose main location includes the nucleus. Which of the partners have a validated prognostic association (favourable or unfavourable) in any TCGA cancer cohort? Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene, Ensembl, Interactions, \"Subcellular main location\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE Gene = 'TP53'"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT Ensembl AS tp53 FROM proteinatlas WHERE Gene='TP53'), partners AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 THEN i.ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE i.ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus i CROSS JOIN p WHERE i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 OR i.ensembl_gene_id_2=p.tp53) SELECT COUNT(*) AS partners_in_network, COUNT(pa.Gene) AS annotated_partners, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pa.\"Subcellular main location\" IS NULL OR pa.\"Subcellular main location\"='') AS missing_location FROM partners x LEFT JOIN proteinatlas pa ON x.ensembl=pa.Ensembl"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT Ensembl AS tp53 FROM proteinatlas WHERE Gene='TP53'), partners AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 THEN i.ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE i.ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus i CROSS JOIN p WHERE i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 OR i.ensembl_gene_id_2=p.tp53) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(pa.\"Subcellular main location\",''),'Not available') AS main_location, COUNT(*) AS n FROM partners x LEFT JOIN proteinatlas pa ON x.ensembl=pa.Ensembl GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT Ensembl AS tp53 FROM proteinatlas WHERE Gene='TP53'), partners AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 THEN i.ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE i.ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus i CROSS JOIN p WHERE i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 OR i.ensembl_gene_id_2=p.tp53) SELECT c.Gene, c.\"Gene name\", c.Cancer, c.\"validated prognostic - favorable\" AS favorable, c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS unfavorable FROM cancer_prognostic_data c JOIN proteinatlas pa ON pa.Gene=c.Gene JOIN partners x ON x.ensembl=pa.Ensembl WHERE COALESCE(c.\"validated prognostic - favorable\",'')<>'' OR COALESCE(c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\",'')<>'' ORDER BY c.Gene,c.Cancer"}

tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH p AS (SELECT Ensembl AS tp53 FROM proteinatlas WHERE Gene='TP53'), partners AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 THEN i.ensembl_gene_id_2 ELSE i.ensembl_gene_id_1 END AS ensembl FROM interaction_consensus i CROSS JOIN p WHERE i.ensembl_gene_id_1=p.tp53 OR i.ensembl_gene_id_2=p.tp53) SELECT c.\"Gene name\" AS gene, c.Cancer AS tcga_cohort, c.\"validated prognostic - favorable\" AS favorable_p, c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS unfavorable_p FROM cancer_prognostic_data c JOIN partners x ON x.ensembl=c.Gene WHERE (c.\"validated prognostic - favorable\"<>'' OR c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\"<>'') AND c.Cancer LIKE '%(TCGA)' ORDER BY gene,tcga_cohort"}
